title: Backups and recovery
introduction: Backups are saved on the computer running the service. Snapshots wait for tasks, approvals and unconfirmed operations to finish without interrupting running tasks.
continues: The service continues processing after you close this page.
empty: No backups yet. Create your first snapshot, or one will be created before an upgrade.
protected: Retained for upgrade recovery · Do not delete
verified: Backup verified again. It can be used with this version’s recovery procedure.
recoveryWarning: Preview recovery in the server’s terminal first, then stop the service and confirm using the same backup ID. Recovery replaces configuration and application data, discarding application data created after the backup.
recoveryPreview: The preview shows what will be replaced, compatibility and the next confirmation steps.
included: Includes Covro service configuration, project registrations, preferences and application database records. Back up Codex conversation content, credentials, attachments, artifacts and project files separately.
retention: Backups are not deleted automatically. Keep backups needed for upgrade recovery; copies of original files saved before restoration also use disk space.
loadFailed: Cannot load backup records. Please try again.
operationFailed: The backup operation failed. Please try again.
unavailable: Backups are unavailable for this service. See the technical details.
description_waiting: Waiting for tasks, approvals, input and unconfirmed operations to finish.
description_copying: Creating a snapshot of the database and configuration.
description_verifying: Checking file integrity and database compatibility.
description_succeeded: The verified snapshot is ready for offline recovery.
description_failed: No recoverable snapshot was created. Check configuration, directory permissions and disk space before retrying.
description_cancelled: The backup was cancelled. No recoverable snapshot was created.
description_interrupted: The process was interrupted before a recoverable snapshot was completed.
description_corrupt: This backup is damaged, incomplete or incompatible with the current version. It cannot be restored.
